The system should run without errors, correctly read lineup announcements and injury reports, and produce adjusted forecasts. On these test games I expect to see starters correctly identified from lineup data, p_play adjustments from injury reports, and minutes adjustments from historical bias correction. The key test is that the code runs clean.

The system should produce a minutes pinball loss ratio below 1.0 (better than reference). Key improvements expected: (1) Lineup-based starter identification should improve p_start accuracy and minutes allocation for 37/43 games, (2) Historical per-player bias correction should shift median minutes toward actual trends, (3) Width calibration should adjust range width based on observed coverage. If lineup reading still fails in sandbox, the ratio will likely be near 1.0 with slight improvement from historical bias correction only. The fallback to reference ensures ratio cannot be much worse than 1.0.
